summary: Full E2E validation of Nicole's AI Studio landing page. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed (health, waitlist create, duplicate 409, invalid 422, count, case-insensitive dup). Frontend: all 6 landing sections render, nav smooth-scrolls to Features/Workflow/Waitlist, waitlist count loads, valid email submission returns position and shows success card with correct email + builder #, 'Add another email' resets to form (empty input), duplicate email shows sonner error toast 'Email already on the waitlist.'. Invalid email input is blocked by browser HTML5 email validation before submit (backend 422 path not reachable from UI, which is acceptable UX).
critical_code_review_comments: Waitlist.jsx: since input has type='email' + required, the invalid email UX is fully handled by the browser and the backend 422 toast branch is effectively dead code. Not a bug, just note.
server.py: uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider FastAPI lifespan handler.
server.py: CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — some browsers reject this combo. Consider explicit origins in production.
Waitlist position returned as current total count; concurrent submissions could return the same position under race conditions. Low priority for a waitlist.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created ~3 TEST_ prefixed waitlist entries during testing (test_*@example.com). No cleanup endpoint exists; safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is a single landing page (Nicole's AI Studio) with waitlist. Backend endpoints: POST /api/waitlist (200/409/422), GET /api/waitlist/count. All UI tests use data-testid selectors defined in components. Use unique random emails for waitlist tests. HTML5 email validation prevents malformed emails from being submitted from UI, so 422 toast is not reachable via UI - test 422 only at API level.
